__comment: Round 13 D1 — production-health dashboard. Every metric below already exists in code from prior rounds but had no panel or threshold until now. Grafana schema abbreviated to the query + threshold intent per panel; import into Grafana (Dashboards → Import) and bind to the Prometheus datasource.
title: Scraper Engine — Production Health

panels.title: Validated Proxy Pool
panels.note: critical_below matches the existing ProxyPoolCriticallyLow alert (< 5).

panels.title: Safe-Content Guard Firings (Level 3)
panels.note: Expected near-zero. Sustained nonzero means real targets are triggering the mid-navigation race this guard protects against (round 12.4). Bound to the SafeContentGuardFiringFrequently alert.

panels.title: Per-Source Proxy Health
panels.note: 1 = source returned >=1 proxy last cycle, 0 = dark. Bound to ProxySourceWentDark (round 13 D2). One row per source_name label.

panels.title: Per-Tenant Quota Utilization
panels.note: Per-tenant. Emitted into a void until this panel existed.
